verdict.rationale: Migration credits are a fair pricing question for a cloud hosting platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers pay-as-you-go pricing and a claim that customers won't need to migrate as they grow, but it never mentions credits, promotions, or incentives for moving workloads onto Fly.io.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform
